title: ixora recurva
intro: Ixora recurva, commonly known as Jungle geranium or Flame of the Woods, is a flowering plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia. It is known for its vibrant red, orange, or yellow flowers and is often used in traditional medicine to promote health and wellness. The health benefits of Ixora recurva include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and anxiety, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Ixora recurva include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of promoting relaxation, reducing pain, and protecting against oxidative stress.
